items.note: 120 seats, 3.25% threshold. i24/Direct Polls 18 Oct: Likud 25, Yashar (Eisenkot) 21, Together (Bennett) 13, Otzma 10, Democrats 9; coalition 57 (per article). Poll publication ban from end of Fri 23 Oct. Polls normally close 22:00 local (=21:00 CET after Israel DST ends 25 Oct) with TV exit polls immediately - verify. Polymarket: Yashar most seats 0.695, Likud 0.295; next PM Eisenkot 0.49, Netanyahu 0.295, Bennett 0.145.

items.title: Israel votes in Knesset election
items.title_cs: Izraelci volí nový Kneset
items.note: Election for all 120 seats of the 26th Knesset; closed-list PR, one nationwide constituency, threshold 3.25%, majority 61. Most stations open 7am-10pm, those in line at closing may vote; election day is a national holiday. ~7.3 million eligible voters (CEC). 38 lists filed. Diplomatic-mission voting took place 20 Oct. Outgoing Knesset: coalition 60 (Likud 32, Shas 11, RZP 7, Otzma 6, New Hope 4), opposition 59 + Noam 1. Forecast: does any bloc reach 61? Resolution: CEC results (votes.bechirot.gov.il) and media counts overnight 27/28 Oct.

items.note: Final polls (published Fri 23 Oct): Kan 11 (Kantar) Yashar 22, Likud 20, B'Yachad 14, Democrats 8, Joint List 9, Otzma 8, Yisrael Beytenu 8, UTJ 8, Shas 7, RZP-Zehut 7, Ra'am 5, Reservists-Economic 4; blocs change 52 / Netanyahu 50 / Arab 14. Channel 12 (Midgam): Yashar 23, Likud 21, B'Yachad 15, Democrats 10, Joint List 9, Otzma 8, YB 8, UTJ 7, Shas 8, RZP-Zehut 6, Ra'am 5; blocs 56/50/14. Channel 13: Yashar 22, Likud 19, B'Yachad 14, Democrats 10, JL 9, Otzma 8, YB 8, UTJ 8, Shas 7, RZP-Zehut 8, Ra'am 7; blocs 54/50/16. Claim: Yashar largest party in exit polls / final count (yes/no). items.title: Israel: will Netanyahu's bloc win 61 seats?
items.title_cs: Získá Netanjahuův blok 61 mandátů?
items.note: All three final TV polls give Netanyahu bloc (Likud, Shas, UTJ, Otzma, RZP-Zehut) 50 seats and the change bloc 52-56; neither reaches 61 without Arab parties (14-16). i24/Direct Polls 18 Oct: coalition 57. Claim: Netanyahu bloc <61 in final count (likely yes per polls). Official results confirmed 4 Nov (Wikipedia). Surplus pacts: Together+YB, Yashar+Democrats, JL+Ra'am, Likud+RZP-Zehut, Shas+UTJ.
